The affix क्यप् is used after the root खन 'to dig' and long ई is substituted for the final of the root.

Terms: क्यप्

The acutely accented (उदात्त) ई is substituted for the final of 1. अस्थि 2. दधि 3. सक्थि and 4. अक्षि in the छन्दस् (Vedas) when the case-affixes of the dual follow.

Terms: नुम् augment

In the reduplicated Aorist of the Causative, ई is substituted optionally for the vowel of the reduplicate in गण्।

Terms: Reduplicate
